name: Whitley Bay Holiday Park
stayType: Holiday park with caravans and lodges
accommodation: Self-catering caravans with 2 or 3 bedrooms sleeping up to 8, plus lodges
suitableFor: Families and groups wanting self-catering with on-site entertainment
parking: Mainly communal; contact the park to request a space
dogs: Listed as dog friendly; nature reserve suitable for dog walks
beachAccess: Beach within easy walking distance of the park
confirmedFeatures: Heated indoor pool (seasonal), adventure playground, multisport court, arcade, bar and restaurant, showbar, Costa Coffee, takeaways, in-venue Wi-Fi
overview: A Parkdean Resorts holiday park on the edge of Whitley Bay, close to St Mary's Lighthouse and a Blue Flag beach. It offers caravans and lodges with a full set of on-site facilities including an indoor pool, bar and restaurant. Longsands at Tynemouth lies a short drive south along the coast road.
surfTripFit: A self-catering option for families, with its own beach on foot and Longsands a short drive away.
